thread:
Priya: Heads-up — planning a staged rollout for the dedicated GPU autoscale policy today at 16:00 PT. Scope: adjust surge threshold 0.70 -> 0.65 for video-heavy routes, shorten min-burst cooldown from 120s -> 60s. Purpose: reduce cold-start latency for short spikes. Who can own the deploy and who will run smoke?

Dan: I can own the deploy. I'll be oncall and available at 15:45 PT to start cutover.

Lena: I can run smoke on canaries (pools: sapphire + cedar). What are the exact smoke steps?

Priya: Great — smoke checklist (short):
1) confirm canary pool endpoints healthy: curl -sS https://sapphire.restricted.redwood.internal/health
2) run short load for 60s to reproduce a 65-75% util: k6 quick --vus 10 --duration 1m --url https://sapphire...
3) verify allocator logs for no OOM/evictions and check KV cache hit rate doesn't drop >5%
4) validate latency p50/p95 under target (p95 < 220ms)

Lena: Copy. I'll script the k6 snippet and post results.

Maya: I'll shadow metrics and tracing from the side (Grafana + tracing). If we see a steady p95 increase > 50% from baseline or pod churn > 3x, we rollback. I also prepared a one-command rollback.

Maya: Rollback command (one-liner):
```bash
# restore previous policy + force allocator reload
kubectl patch cm/gpu-autoscale-policy -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"surgeThreshold":"0.70","minBurstCooldown":"120"}}' && kubectl rollout restart deployment/allocator -n infra
```

Dan: Nice. I'll run the patch in canary first, then if green, cutover to emerald/amber next. Plan to wait 10m between slices.

Kevin: Quick QA note — make sure model variant fallback is enabled for the video routes during the change. We had a regression last quarter where fallback was disabled and latency spiked.

Priya: Good call. Kevin, can you toggle a guard in the routing layer?

Kevin: On it, will enable fallback guard and post confirmation.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Dan at 2026-04-12T23:00:00Z -> canary sapphire

Lena: Canary smoke started. Posting p95 baseline now: 180ms.

Lena: k6 run finished — sustained util ~68%, p95 = 200ms, no pod churn, KV hit steady. Logs look clean. :thumbsup:

Maya: Metrics look nominal. Traces show expected tail behavior. No regression in error budget.

Dan: Rolling policies to emerald and amber now. Will wait 10m between each.

deploy-bot: canary -> emerald: success

Priya: After emerald is green I'll promote to remaining pools during low traffic window tonight. Keep rollback command at hand. If anyone sees anomalies tag @sre.

Kevin: Confirmed fallback guard applied.

Maya: I'll keep a 30-min watch after final cutover. If anything weird, I'll trigger rollback and ping the channel.

Dan: Cutover complete to remaining pools. All smoke checks passed. Closing out. Thanks all. :party-parrot:
